title: Enable Queue priority multi-select clicks
summary: Enable real Queue row Ctrl/Cmd-click and Shift-click multi-selection for bulk priority toolbar actions.
reason: The Queue selection module already tracks multi-selection, but the shared row helper drops DOM events before modifier keys reach the Queue handler.
behavior_before: Rendered Queue row clicks always reached the selection handler without the original click or keyboard event, so Ctrl/Cmd-click and Shift-click behaved like ordinary single-row selection.
behavior_after: Rendered selectable rows forward click and keyboard events to selection handlers, allowing Queue priority selection to honor Ctrl/Cmd-click toggles, Shift-click visible ranges, and Space toggles.
